pilot.selection: Geometric mean of median throughput at both pilot batch sizes; final samples independent.

interpreter_scope: Scalar/SIMD rows evaluate lowered fixed-shape instructions, not the general reactive runtime or a nalgebra source interpreter.

contract.mech_source: Common constraint-free numerical EKF source; no predicate-only helpers.
contract.inputs: Three shared contiguous little-endian f32 arrays: velocity, angular velocity, bearing; reused each turn.
contract.outputs: Complete final state and covariance; canonical dump has C-order state (N,3) then covariance (N,3,3).
contract.timing: Twenty dependent state updates; final public host-readable state included. Excludes compilation, initial allocation/setup, input binding, warmup/reset, checksums and file output. Includes allocations inside execution.
contract.publication: Final host-readable output only; no inter-turn host snapshot or turn fusion. Public API snapshot conversion cost is included where required.
contract.optimization: Generic component-contiguous array execution, SIMD over cache tiles, ordered short contractions, and version-aware common sine/cosine sharing; no EKF-specific native code. Selected NumPy implementation is unchanged. No performance-derived tolerance or fastest-sample selection.
